production_material_full_kit_proofs.declaration:
CREATE TABLE production_material_full_kit_proofs (
 id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 execution_segment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES production_execution_segments(id),
 planned_qty NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(planned_qty>0),
 rules_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rules_version=1),
 source_stock_order BIGINT NOT NULL,
 ledger_order BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 created_transaction xid8 NOT NULL DEFAULT pg_current_xact_id(),
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);

production_material_full_kit_proof_items.declaration:
CREATE TABLE production_material_full_kit_proof_items (
 proof_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES production_material_full_kit_proofs(id),
 demand_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES production_material_demands(id),
 supported_qty NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(supported_qty>=0),
 identity_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(proof_id,demand_id)
);

production_material_full_kit_proofs_pkey.declaration: id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
production_material_full_kit_proofs_pkey.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX production_material_full_kit_proofs_pkey ON public.production_material_full_kit_proofs USING btree (id)

production_material_full_kit_proofs_ledg.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX production_material_full_kit_proofs_ledger_order_key ON public.production_material_full_kit_proofs USING btree (ledger_order)

idx_material_full_kit_proof_segment.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_material_full_kit_proof_segment ON public.production_material_full_kit_proofs USING btree (execution_segment_id, ledger_order DESC)

production_material_full_kit_proof_items.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX production_material_full_kit_proof_items_pkey ON public.production_material_full_kit_proof_items USING btree (proof_id, demand_id)

uq_material_stock_posting_ledger_order.declaration:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_material_stock_posting_ledger_order
    ON production_material_stock_postings(ledger_order) WHERE ledger_order IS NOT NULL;
uq_material_stock_posting_ledger_order.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_material_stock_posting_ledger_order ON public.production_material_stock_postings USING btree (ledger_order) WHERE (ledger_order IS NOT NULL)

idx_material_issue_reverse_proof.declaration:
CREATE INDEX idx_material_issue_reverse_proof ON production_material_stock_postings(demand_id,ledger_order)
 WHERE posting_type='ISSUE_REVERSE' AND ledger_order IS NOT NULL;
idx_material_issue_reverse_proof.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_material_issue_reverse_proof ON public.production_material_stock_postings USING btree (demand_id, ledger_order) WHERE ((posting_type = 'ISSUE_REVERSE'::text) AND (ledger_order IS NOT NULL))

idx_material_posting_demand_order.declaration:
